correctness.rationale: For every tree, F_T(p)=sum_j a_j(T)p^(j+1) follows from survival of all j+1 vertices on each unique path. Equal-order tree differences have p³(1-p) factors. Under t=p/(1-p), exact integer transformed coefficients and Descartes variations bound interior zeros. Independently regenerated every unlabeled tree with NetworkX graph atlas generator through n=11; tree counts for n=4..11 equal 2,3,6,11,23,47,106,235 and distinct distance-vector counts 2,3,6,11,23,45,104,215. All profile pairs have <=1 sign variation except a single n=11 pair with two; its residual 3p³+p²-3p+1 has discriminant -76 and sole real root <0. Independent direct breadth-first distance calculation for both 12-node witnesses gives (11,14,14,12,8,5,2) and (11,15,11,13,10,6,0), yielding D=p³(p-1)(2p-1)(p³+p²-1), with exactly two simple roots in (0,1). These finite checks exhaust the bounded lower domain; no claim made for all n>=12.
